user_prompt: Look up 'COVID-19 economic impact' and summarise the key effects on household income. Then calculate how much more expensive a $1000 monthly basket becomes after 2 years of 8.5% annual inflation. Also analyse the real value of a $1000 monthly income after those 2 years.
final_answer: The key effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on household income include job losses, reduced working hours, and economic uncertainties which have impacted many families worldwide. A monthly basket that costs $1000 would become approximately $177.23 more expensive after 2 years with an annual inflation rate of 8.5%. The real value of a $1000 monthly income after these 2 years, accounting for the same inflation rate, would be around $849.46.
